required: pinned compiler image with the vendored /opt/treesitter venv

applicability: any checkout with at least one file a pinned grammar parses; otherwise SKIPPED not-applicable-language-absent

container_timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock limit for the container (tree-sitter AST).
container_timeout_seconds.scale: Grows with target size; tree-sitter parses ~50-100 MB/min per core (docs/language-servers.md section 5).

container_memory_bytes.description: Memory limit for the container (tree-sitter AST).
container_memory_bytes.scale: Grows with target size; tree-sitter parses ~50-100 MB/min per core (docs/language-servers.md section 5).

container_cpu_millis.scale: Grows with target size; tree-sitter parses ~50-100 MB/min per core (docs/language-servers.md section 5).

container_pids.scale: Grows with target size; tree-sitter parses ~50-100 MB/min per core (docs/language-servers.md section 5).

container_tmpfs_bytes.scale: Grows with target size; tree-sitter parses ~50-100 MB/min per core (docs/language-servers.md section 5).

container_stdout_limit_bytes.description: Captured stdout; beyond this the log is truncated (tree-sitter AST).
container_stdout_limit_bytes.scale: Grows with target size; tree-sitter parses ~50-100 MB/min per core (docs/language-servers.md section 5).

container_stderr_limit_bytes.description: Captured stderr; beyond this the log is truncated (tree-sitter AST).
container_stderr_limit_bytes.scale: Grows with target size; tree-sitter parses ~50-100 MB/min per core (docs/language-servers.md section 5).

image_id.description: Pinned compiler image whose /opt/treesitter venv (py-tree-sitter and every pinned grammar) runs treesitter_ast.py.

max_file_bytes.description: Largest file parsed; larger files are recorded as file-too-large gaps.
max_file_bytes.scale: Generated amalgamations (sqlite3.c ~9 MB) exceed it and are gaps.

max_files.description: Most files parsed; the rest are max-files gaps.

max_rows_per_file.description: Most functions, calls and imports kept per file; the rest are rows-truncated gaps.
